diagnosis: Customer had a 14-day outage and wants to replay missed webhooks. KB-0015 states manual replay is only available for 7 days after retries exhaust. The outage duration exceeds the replay window.
reply: Unfortunately, events become unavailable for manual replay after seven days following the initial delivery attempts. Since your outage lasted two weeks, the missed events are no longer retained in the replay queue. Going forward, you may want to implement a catch-up mechanism using our data export or API polling capabilities as a backup.
